sequence.description: I5: With ssoIssuer pinned, attempt to authenticate using a forged assertion with a different Issuer; login must be rejected to prevent accepting assertions from unintended upstream.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Effective permissions must be bounded by UpstreamIntent; if the connector pins the IdP issuer, assertions from other issuers must not be accepted (otherwise upstream intent is not bound to the configured IdP).

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control SAML login failed; cannot attribute issuer-mismatch rejection/acceptance to issuer validation.
Dex accepted a SAML assertion with an Issuer that does not match pinned ssoIssuer, violating upstream intent binding.
